title: Tour Atlas band file
description: One band and its shows. Every field must be present; use null when a value is unknown and never guess.

shows.description: All shows of the band, past and future. Past shows stay in the file.

id.description: Lowercase ASCII slug of the band name, words joined by hyphens, e.g. "glass-harbor". Must equal the file name without .json.

name.description: Band name as the band writes it.

color.description: Lowercase hex colour like "#3a7bd5", or null to let the app assign one.

tags.description: Tags for this band, chosen only from the enum (maintained in data/tags.json): genre, region, label. Use [] when none clearly applies; never invent tags.

url.description: Page the tour dates were taken from.

retrievedAt.description: Day the page was read, YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: "<band.id>-<date>-<city slug>". Leave null; tools/normalize.ts generates it.

date.description: Day of the show in local time, YYYY-MM-DD. For a multi-day event where the band's day is not announced, the first day of the event.

endDate.description: Last day of a multi-day event, only when the band's exact day is not announced; otherwise null. YYYY-MM-DD.

startTime.description: Local start time of the band's set or the show, 24-hour HH:MM. Null when not announced.

tourName.description: Name of the tour this show belongs to, e.g. "Hollow Tides Tour 2026". Null for one-off shows or when not stated.

eventName.description: Festival or event name when the show is part of one, e.g. "Fjordstorm Festival". Null otherwise.

venue.description: Venue name. Null when not announced.

city.description: City name in Latin script, e.g. "São Paulo", "Tokyo".

region.description: State, province or region when it disambiguates the city, e.g. "OR" for Portland. Null otherwise.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, e.g. "BR".

status.description: Show status as stated by the source. Null when the source does not say.

ticketUrl.description: Ticket page for this show, or null.

sourceUrl.description: Page that lists this show, or null when it is the same as source.url.

notes.description: Short factual note from the source, e.g. "Moved from Kulturhaus". Null otherwise.

geo.description: Coordinates. Leave null; tools/geocode.ts fills them in.

precision.description: Whether the point is the venue itself or the city centre.
